zh.title: 瑞航LX16因客艙煙霧改降班戈 208名乘客及機組員平安
zh.summary: 瑞士國際航空LX16於美東時間7月27日12時14分左右，因商務艙出現來源不明煙霧，改降美國緬因州班戈國際機場（BGR）。航機安全落地，消防檢查未發現火源或異常熱度；SWISS表示208名乘客及機組員均平安。FAA初步資料則記載機組員通報駕駛艙起火，兩種說法仍待調查釐清。
body: 瑞士國際航空（SWISS）一架由蘇黎世飛往紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）的LX16航班，於美國東部夏令時間2026年7月27日約12時14分改降緬因州班戈國際機場。該時間換算為協調世界時7月27日16時14分、台灣時間7月28日0時14分。當地媒體引述航空公司說法指出，機組員因商務艙區域出現煙霧而決定改降；航機其後安全落地，緊急狀況解除。
Portland Press Herald引述SWISS發言人Michael Pelzer表示，航機在班戈安全降落，過程沒有再發生其他事件。當地消防人員落地後檢查航空器，未發現火源或異常熱度。航空公司表示，機上208名乘客及機組員均平安；班戈國際機場跑道因應緊急處置關閉約半小時，並於當地時間約12時30分重新開放。
事件初步描述仍有差異。SWISS對外表示，煙霧出現在商務艙最前方區域；美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的初步事故聲明則記載，機組員曾通報駕駛艙起火。FAA同時註明相關資料屬初步訊息、可能變更。本文因此分別保留航空公司與監管機關的說法，不將「商務艙煙霧」與「駕駛艙起火」視為已獲確認的同一項結論。
SWISS目前尚未確定煙霧來源，並表示將對航空器進行完整檢查，在調查完成前不會推測可能原因。FAA亦表示將調查此事。現階段可確認的結果是LX16已在班戈安全落地、消防檢查未發現火源或異常熱度，且航空公司未通報人員受傷；煙霧的位置、性質與成因仍須等待後續檢查或主管機關更新。

en.title: SWISS LX16 Diverts to Bangor After Smoke; Passengers and Crew Safe
en.summary: SWISS flight LX16 diverted to Bangor International Airport (BGR) at about 12:14 p.m. EDT on July 27 after smoke was reported in the business-class cabin. The Airbus A330 landed safely, and firefighters found no signs of fire or heat. SWISS said all 208 passengers and crew were safe. The FAA’s preliminary statement separately said the crew had reported a cockpit fire, a description that remains subject to change and differs from the airline’s account.
body: SWISS International Air Lines flight LX16, operating from Zurich to New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), diverted to Bangor International Airport in Maine at about 12:14 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time on July 27, 2026. That corresponds to 16:14 UTC on July 27 and 12:14 a.m. in Taiwan on July 28. Local reporting, citing the airline, said the crew diverted after smoke was detected in the business-class section. The aircraft landed safely and the emergency was resolved.

SWISS spokesperson Michael Pelzer told the Portland Press Herald that the aircraft landed in Bangor without further incident. Local firefighters inspected the aircraft after landing and found no signs of fire or heat. The airline said all 208 passengers and crew were safe. Bangor International Airport’s runway was closed for roughly half an hour during the response and reopened at around 12:30 p.m. local time.

The initial descriptions of the event are not identical. SWISS said the unexplained smoke was in the forward part of the business-class cabin. The Federal Aviation Administration’s preliminary incident statement said the crew had reported a cockpit fire. The FAA states that its initial information is preliminary and subject to change. AVWIRE is therefore preserving the two attributed descriptions separately rather than treating either location or the presence of fire as a settled conclusion.

SWISS said it had not determined what caused the smoke and would conduct a thorough inspection of the aircraft, adding that it would not speculate before that work was completed. The FAA also said it would investigate. The confirmed outcome at this stage is that LX16 landed safely at Bangor, firefighters detected no fire or heat during their inspection, and the airline reported no injuries. The location, nature and cause of the smoke remain subject to further examination and official updates.
